title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E01 — Alone In The Arctic, Space Shuttle Macgyver and Angelic Organ
Don Wildman examines a pocket calendar that belonged to a woman stranded in the Arctic, a space shuttle that was at the center of a harrowing ordeal more than 200 miles above Earth and a musical instrument which produced heavenly sounds.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E02 — Transatlantic Zeppelin, Potato Pool and The Lost Inca City
Don Wildman examines an engineer's daring mission to save a high-flying Zeppelin, a pint-sized prodigy's plan to play pool and an explorer's lifelong quest to uncover an ancient lost Inca city.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E03 — Miss Unsinkable, Crop Circles and Detective Goodwin
A Titanic survivor plagued by disaster; the cause of mysterious crop circles in England; the case that created the first NYPD female detective.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E04 — Project Vortex, Diamond Heist and Tinseltown, NJ
Investigating a scientist's attempt to document the life cycle of a tornado; a record-breaking $100 million heist; a pioneering filmmaker who went head-to-head against Thomas Edison.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E05 — Mystery Of Silence, Fearless Flyer and Fifty Stars
Don Wildman examines a printing press connected to a Founding Father's secret identity, a model plane with the propeller in the back flown by a record-setting aviatrix and an American flag designed by a high school kid.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E06 — Eisenhower's Crazy Convoy, Criminal Measures and Canyon Adventure
Don Wildman investigates a president's cross-country road trip, a detective's plan to cut down on crime and an explorers dangerous quest to be the first to uncover the secrets of the Grand Canyon.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E07 — Dewey Defeats Truman, the Real Jekyll and Hyde and Sunken Steamship Treasure
Don Wildman examines how an iconic headline came to be, the real-life inspiration for a literary villain and the search for millions of dollars of sunken treasure.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E08 — Winnie The Bear, Frozen Miracle and Whiskey Galore
Don Wildman examines a stuffed bear that inspired one of the greatest children's books of all time, a fireman's pike used in an icy rescue mission and a bottle of whiskey that was once at the center of an illegal escapade.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S16 E13 — Undercover Informant, the Black Beetle and Unexpected Artist
Don Wildman examines the insider who took down Al Capone, a jet engine that was used in a daring railroad experiment and a portrait painted by a woman who overcame insurmountable odds to become a world-renowned artist.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S17 E02 — Antis The Radar Dog, Bringing Up The Baby and The Art Of Murder
Don Wildman investigates a dog with a sixth sense for danger, the harrowing tale of a drill rescue and a magazine detailing the murder of a famous model.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S17 E04 — Dorothy Of Dakota, Crop Circles Of the Deep and Tunnel Of Love
Don Wildman investigates a girl who went over the rainbow, a deep-sea design with mysterious origins and a man who dug his way into a woman's heart.

title: Mysteries at the Museum
description:
S17 E05 — How To Sell The Eiffel Tower, Killer Lake and Cinderella Girl
Don Wildman investigates a legendary scam artist, an African lake with a hidden danger and a young girl who celebrated her birthday at the White House.

title: Mysteries of the Unknown
description:
S05 E25 — Fleeing the Nazis, Atlantis Arises, Bombing of New Mexico
A spy with a wooden leg barely escapes Nazi-occupied France with her life; mysterious stones may be from the ruins of the lost city of Atlantis; twisted shrapnel tells of a near-miss military accident in New Mexico.

title: Mysteries of the Unknown
description:
S05 E26 — Oak Island Treasure, Origin of the Nobel Prize, Oregon Trail Coffin
A ghostly pirate may be protecting his buried treasure on a remote island; a coffin carries a whiskey-preserved body across the Oregon Trail; the inventor of dynamite writes a will that changes the world forever.

title: Mysteries of the Unknown
description:
S05 E27 — Chaplin Grave Robbery, Ghost Will, Roller Skate Rivalry
Grave robbers steal the corpse of an international movie star; a dispute over a will is resolved when a ghost reveals the existence of a second will; the inventor of roller skates loses himself in legal battles over his creation.
